33b3f951ecfc958b8628.en: An apostrophe can take the place of missing letters. Do not becomes don't.
33b3f951ecfc958b8628.id: Apostrof (apostrophe) bisa menggantikan huruf yang hilang. Do not menjadi don't.

fe4e4fe2e47440ce7593.en: An apostrophe and s show who owns something. One owner takes 's.
fe4e4fe2e47440ce7593.id: Apostrof dan s menunjukkan siapa pemilik sesuatu. Satu pemilik memakai 's.

31d361e14640f607a9d5.en: A plural that ends in s takes only the apostrophe after it.
31d361e14640f607a9d5.id: Bentuk jamak (plural) yang berakhiran s hanya memakai apostrof setelahnya.

6a14b17e97b294c8dba8.en: Its with no apostrophe shows belonging. It's means it is or it has.
6a14b17e97b294c8dba8.id: Its tanpa apostrof menunjukkan milik. It's berarti it is atau it has.

e2923506ac61701aa38a.en: One boy owns the hat, so we write the boy's hat.
e2923506ac61701aa38a.id: Topi itu milik satu anak laki-laki, jadi kita menulis the boy's hat.

d6e50e8977e7d6bd6e19.en: There is no apostrophe to show belonging.
d6e50e8977e7d6bd6e19.id: Tidak ada tanda apostrof untuk menunjukkan kepemilikan.

8ac1ebb114bc3d7dbda3.en: This shows the hat belongs to more than one boy.
8ac1ebb114bc3d7dbda3.id: Ini menunjukkan hat itu milik lebih dari satu boy.

5994c04a57110282f796.en: This is not the correct form.

74bb649d5b55b5ef3d09.en: It's means it is, so It's a lovely day is correct.
74bb649d5b55b5ef3d09.id: It's berarti it is, jadi It's a lovely day itu benar.

cd5b13a17c2734792844.en: Its with no apostrophe cannot mean it is.
cd5b13a17c2734792844.id: Its tanpa tanda apostrof tidak bisa berarti it is.

73cbd9aa44d0c5b1919b.en: Belonging uses its, with no apostrophe.
73cbd9aa44d0c5b1919b.id: Kepemilikan memakai its, tanpa tanda apostrof.

305120f761444ea35043.en: The apostrophe does not go after the s.
305120f761444ea35043.id: Tanda apostrof tidak ditulis setelah s.

349a6cd55f5141fda81a.en: In "do not" the o of not is missing, so we write don't. The apostrophe sits where the o was.
349a6cd55f5141fda81a.id: Pada "do not", huruf o dari not hilang, jadi kita menulis don't. Apostrof (apostrophe) berada di tempat huruf o tadi.

1ff8ee081369ccf75c9c.en: The apostrophe goes where the letter o is missing, not at the end.
1ff8ee081369ccf75c9c.id: Tanda apostrof ditulis di tempat huruf o yang hilang, bukan di akhir.

f664a32db4145b50c7ec.en: The apostrophe must sit in the place of the missing o, which is after the n.
f664a32db4145b50c7ec.id: Tanda apostrof harus ada di tempat huruf o yang hilang, yaitu setelah n.

6af6c7e282b3074f0c23.en: The apostrophe is in the wrong place, so the word looks odd.
6af6c7e282b3074f0c23.id: Tanda apostrofnya ada di tempat yang salah, jadi katanya terlihat aneh.

b99529c1560beb94037f.en: She is becomes she's. The apostrophe takes the place of the letter i.
b99529c1560beb94037f.id: She is menjadi she's. Apostrof (apostrophe) menggantikan huruf i.

8ca7f3e9bba63a080fed.en: For a single owner we add an apostrophe and s: the dog's bowl.
8ca7f3e9bba63a080fed.id: Untuk satu pemilik, kita menambahkan apostrof (apostrophe) dan s: the dog's bowl.

79c08baf3044013dc250.en: Without an apostrophe it is not clear that the bowl belongs to the dog.
79c08baf3044013dc250.id: Tanpa tanda apostrof, tidak jelas bahwa bowl itu milik dog.

52cbbd9fa0a69443abb1.en: This shows more than one dog owns the bowl.
52cbbd9fa0a69443abb1.id: Ini menunjukkan bowl itu milik lebih dari satu dog.

13aaeda80c79bda35ac2.en: The words are not joined into a possessive form.
13aaeda80c79bda35ac2.id: Kata-katanya tidak digabung menjadi bentuk kepemilikan.

f1417f79ea50baf3ad55.en: It's is short for it is. Its with no apostrophe means belonging to it, like his or her.
f1417f79ea50baf3ad55.id: It's adalah bentuk pendek dari it is. Its tanpa apostrof (apostrophe) berarti milik benda itu, seperti his atau her.

6026871be818cd06dde7.en: Kofi owns the football, so we write Kofi's with an apostrophe and s.
6026871be818cd06dde7.id: Bola itu milik Kofi, jadi kita menulis Kofi's dengan apostrof (apostrophe) dan s.

b66b3e338efb8be45783.en: The plural girls already ends in s, so we only add an apostrophe after it: the girls' bags.
b66b3e338efb8be45783.id: Bentuk jamak (plural) girls sudah berakhir dengan s, jadi kita hanya menambahkan apostrof setelahnya: the girls' bags.

acd0f9ffa6296d717420.en: The apostrophe is missing, so belonging is not shown.
acd0f9ffa6296d717420.id: Tanda apostrofnya tidak ada, jadi kepemilikan tidak terlihat.

c7cbf5fbf41193ff8b63.en: The plural girls already ends in s, so an extra s is not added.
c7cbf5fbf41193ff8b63.id: Bentuk jamak (plural) girls sudah berakhir dengan s, jadi tidak perlu ditambah s lagi.

c04baefa01a8a394cbfc.en: Wulan's bike, the teacher's desk and the children's toys show who owns something. Can't, we've and they'd have missing letters.
c04baefa01a8a394cbfc.id: Wulan's bike, the teacher's desk, dan the children's toys menunjukkan siapa pemilik sesuatu. Can't, we've, dan they'd punya huruf yang hilang.

a1489d46fb505197bb28.en: Children is an irregular plural that does not end in s, so we add 's: children's toys.
a1489d46fb505197bb28.id: Children adalah bentuk jamak (plural) tidak beraturan yang tidak berakhir dengan s, jadi kita menambahkan 's: children's toys.

777fcef521190f233646.en: It's means it is. In "it is time to go home" the short form works, so it's is right.
777fcef521190f233646.id: It's berarti it is. Pada "it is time to go home", bentuk pendeknya cocok, jadi it's itu benar.

06cb7319eb4057f02d33.en: It's means it is, so this does not make sense.
06cb7319eb4057f02d33.id: It's berarti it is, jadi kalimat ini tidak masuk akal.

dcff3942c5e45242260b.en: They are becomes they're, would not becomes wouldn't, and it has becomes it's.
dcff3942c5e45242260b.id: They are menjadi they're, would not menjadi wouldn't, dan it has menjadi it's.

41e6794148363f792ec5.en: The babies' cots and the men's team show belonging correctly, and James's hat is also fine. The other two sentences use apostrophes incorrectly.
41e6794148363f792ec5.id: The babies' cots dan the men's team menunjukkan kepemilikan dengan benar, dan James's hat juga benar. Dua kalimat lainnya salah memakai apostrof.

b4150b574797999f07de.en: Plural birds does not need an apostrophe, because nothing belongs to it.
b4150b574797999f07de.id: Bentuk jamak (plural) birds tidak perlu tanda apostrof, karena tidak ada yang dimilikinya.

7afbee8a5d4d092bd06e.en: Its been means it has been, so it needs it's.
7afbee8a5d4d092bd06e.id: Its been berarti it has been, jadi perlu it's.

a593df973f79d54935d5.en: "Mum's gone" means "Mum has gone", so the apostrophe stands for missing letters. The other three show who owns something.
a593df973f79d54935d5.id: "Mum's gone" berarti "Mum has gone", jadi apostrof itu menggantikan huruf yang hilang. Tiga kalimat lainnya menunjukkan siapa pemilik sesuatu.

415b6fa97584e311e8e5.en: Here the apostrophe shows that the car belongs to Mum.
415b6fa97584e311e8e5.id: Di sini tanda apostrof menunjukkan car itu milik Mum.

40e9a81668a9433be929.en: Here the apostrophe shows that the coach belongs to the team.
40e9a81668a9433be929.id: Di sini tanda apostrof menunjukkan coach itu milik team.

941c56aa8e7bfc0b365c.en: Here the apostrophe shows that the field belongs to the farmers.
941c56aa8e7bfc0b365c.id: Di sini tanda apostrof menunjukkan field itu milik farmers.

c1c096a229793c73ec02.en: Bikes is a plain plural, so it needs no apostrophe. "It is not allowed" needs the short form It's.
c1c096a229793c73ec02.id: Bikes hanya bentuk jamak (plural) biasa, jadi tidak perlu apostrof. "It is not allowed" perlu bentuk pendek It's.

b4e258e913eef36f016c.en: No apostrophe belongs in this word.
b4e258e913eef36f016c.id: Kata ini tidak perlu tanda apostrof.

104c79a07a528e66b6eb.en: This word is fine as it is.
104c79a07a528e66b6eb.id: Kata ini sudah benar seperti itu.

8db3a6c71e7b9736c897.en: The plural pupils ends in s, so we add an apostrophe after it: the pupils' hats.
8db3a6c71e7b9736c897.id: Bentuk jamak (plural) pupils berakhir dengan s, jadi kita menambahkan apostrof setelahnya: the pupils' hats.
